primary_frame.name: full_1872
domain_terms: fixed outside-NRB indicator for CRZ, MMSB, NKB and SRB

secondary_frame.name: nrb_3a_plus_3b_1677
secondary_frame.role: descriptive; no outside-NRB indicator; no verdicts

folds: V15 fold IDs copied unchanged: 1 = NRB_3b only; 2 = mixed; 3-4 = NRB_3a only
fault_distance: Rebuilt from the Phase 2 CACB structure variant; training-fold standardization; quadratic term formed after standardization
area: log_area_km2 fixed offset with coefficient one

models.N0_global: global terms; outside-NRB only in the primary frame

decision_rule.pooled: upper model improves both mean held-out log score and ROC-AUC
decision_rule.uncertainty: 95% 25-km spatial-block bootstrap interval for mean log-score gain excludes zero
decision_rule.fold_replication: mean log-score gain is positive in >= 3 of 4 folds
decision_rule.coefficient_n1_n2: a majority (>= 2 of 4) of the added 3b x distance coefficients has a 95% interval excluding zero in >= 3 of 4 folds
decision_rule.coefficient_n2_n3: the 3b x gravity interaction interval excludes zero in >= 3 of 4 folds

descriptive_check: N1-to-N2 and N2-to-N3 comparisons within Fold 2 only, because Fold 2 is the only mixed fold
